title: Homework reminder payload-hash dedup prevents 8x re-fire across multi-instance states
desc: Process-wide _lastHomeworkHash and _lastHomeworkFiredAt fields prevent identical payload from re-firing within 10min regardless of which instance state triggered. Auto-clears when pending count drops or list changes.
steps: Add static _lastHomeworkHash _lastHomeworkCount _lastHomeworkFiredAt to CheckAndSendHomework owner class (process-wide dedup)
Update _lastHomeworkHash + _lastHomeworkFiredAt only on successful MCP delivery -- failed retries don't poison cooldown
Auto-clear hash when pending.Count drops to 0 -- ensures fresh fire for next non-empty list
WKAPPBOT_NO_HOMEWORK_NAG env override (optional future): set to 1 to disable homework nags entirely for testing
author: claude
